description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering project report search parameters within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes properties for project ID and timesheet inclusion criteria, extending a date range search filter.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Time\Dto\ProjectReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters for project reports, including project ID and timesheet parameters, extending date range filters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class and sets the default sort field to 'projectActivity.name'.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Returns the project ID used as a filter in the search.

methods.name: setProjectId
methods.description: Sets the project ID filter value.

methods.name: getIncludeApproveTimesheet
methods.description: Returns the timesheet inclusion criterion for the filter.
